{
  "candidate_rtl": "module addr_calcu(
    input [7:0] address,
    input [7:0] ptr1, ptr2,
    input [7:0] b,
    input control,
    output [15:0] count
);
    parameter [7:0] base = 8'b10000000;

    // Preserve the mandatory modulo-256 offset computation.
    wire [7:0] offset1, offset2, offset;
    assign offset1 = base - ptr1;
    assign offset2 = base - ptr2;
    assign offset = control ? offset1 : offset2;

    // T = address + b + (~offset)[7:0] + 1.
    // Thus count = T - 256, with the final result modulo 65536.
    wire [7:0] inv_offset;
    wire [7:0] sum_bits, carry_bits;
    assign inv_offset = ~offset;
    assign sum_bits = address ^ b ^ inv_offset;
    assign carry_bits = (address & b) |
                        (address & inv_offset) |
                        (b & inv_offset);

    // Carry-save reduction leaves only one carry-propagating addition.
    // The shifted carry operand has a free bit zero for the constant +1.
    wire [9:0] x, y;
    assign x = {2'b00, sum_bits};
    assign y = {1'b0, carry_bits, 1'b1};

    // Explicit parallel-prefix carry computation for the 10-bit sum.
    wire [9:0] p0, g0, p1, g1, p2, g2;
    wire [9:0] p4, g4, g8;
    wire [9:0] t;
    assign p0 = x ^ y;
    assign g0 = x & y;

    assign p1 = p0 & {p0[8:0], 1'b1};
    assign g1 = g0 | (p0 & {g0[8:0], 1'b0});

    assign p2 = p1 & {p1[7:0], 2'b11};
    assign g2 = g1 | (p1 & {g1[7:0], 2'b00});

    assign p4 = p2 & {p2[5:0], 4'b1111};
    assign g4 = g2 | (p2 & {g2[5:0], 4'b0000});

    assign g8 = g4 | (p4 & {g4[1:0], 8'b00000000});
    assign t = p0 ^ {g8[8:0], 1'b0};

    // T is in [1,766], so T-256 is in [-255,510].
    // Decode the upper byte rather than propagate a 16-bit subtraction.
    wire negative_result;
    assign negative_result = ~(t[9] | t[8]);
    assign count = {{7{negative_result}},
                    (negative_result | t[9]), t[7:0]};
endmodule
",
